description:
AirPods desktop user experience enhancement program


This is a Beta version. If you encounter any questions or bugs while using it, please feel free to open an issue to let us know.
Important
The Windows installers in this release are not Authenticode-signed. Windows may show an unknown publisher or Microsoft Defender SmartScreen warning. Only download files from this official release page.
📜 Change log
1. Redesigned the battery popup to follow the iOS card: battery rings under the pods and the case, a turntable animation while the pods are together, a still picture of each pod and the case when one pod is out, and fades between scenes. The popup now stays up while the case lid is open. (#238, #239, #278)
2. Every model now has its own animation. AirPods Max, AirPods Max (USB-C), Beats Fit Pro, Beats Solo3, Powerbeats 3 and BeatsX are shown in the color of your device, 76 colors in total. (#250, #278)
3. Added support for Beats Solo3, BeatsX and Powerbeats 3, and for the AirPods Max 2 product ID. (#258, #278)
4. AirPods Max now shows a single, centered battery. (#250, #276)
5. Improved connecting from the tray: a redesigned quick connect card, optional automatic connection when audio starts playing, and more reliable battery detection. (#262, #278)
6. Added a setting to turn off the popup when the lid opens. The popup no longer takes focus from the app in use, and no longer reopens when the AirPods reappear with the lid already open. (#246, #249)
7. Fixed automatic ear detection on AirPods Pro 2 when the signal is weak. (#237)
8. Fixed Exit not working while the popup is shown, and a startup failure with error code 5. The installer now closes a running AirPodsDesktop before installing or uninstalling. (#269, #271, #279)
9. Added Polish, Spanish, Persian and Indonesian translations, and completed the existing ones. (#232, #236, #244, #248, #274, #275)
The installer is larger than before (about 200 MB, up from 57 MB) because it now carries an animation for every model and color.
Thanks to @cbittle, @Piteriuz, @z1pp090, @akhmadqasim, @b14ck4nge1, @austinmiller770 and @aaroncheungzy for their first contributions.
Full Changelog: https://github.com/SpriteOvO/AirPodsDesktop/compare/v0.6.1...v0.7.0
